Tuning / timing
Press Listen, then play one clear note.
Use headphones. Timing is an estimate.
Calibration: play 8 attacks on the beat. Play one attack per beat for feedback.
Hum one note at a time. MIDI: one octave lower, fitted to bass range. Feedback: scale fit only.

Record a melody
Sing, hum or play one clear note at a time. Speech may not form steady musical notes. Your microphone stays on this device.
—
Up to 2 minutes. The song is paused to keep its sound out of the recording.
Save as new song keeps this recording in your song library and opens its notes in Piano View. Save any changes to your current song first.
